subject: Next steps: Vendor setup & payment path for Grayline Logistics
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@grayline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor setup & payment path — quick follow-up after demo

Hi Erin,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate you walking us through the use case. To keep momentum, two quick items we discussed:

1) Commercial path: your procurement team indicated preference for a standard PO process (Net 30) but asked whether credit card onboarding could be used for the initial month to speed trial access.
2) Vendor paperwork: to start vendor setup with Finance, we need a completed W-9 (or W-8 for non-US entities), banking instructions, and a primary contact for the vendor portal invite.

I've attached a short vendor packet with the required forms and a suggested checklist so you can see what Finance will need. If you want the card route for the first 30 days, we can enable a self-serve card billing option immediately and then transition to PO after your first purchase order is approved. That option usually reduces time-to-first-charge from ~2 weeks to 24–48 hours.

Could you confirm:
- Whether Grayline wants the card onboarding (temp) or go straight to PO?
- Best person to receive the vendor portal invite and banking info (name + email + phone)?

If helpful, Ben and I can hop on a 20-minute call with procurement to walk Finance through the fields on the forms.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-vendor-packet_20261018.pdf, redwood-w9-template.pdf, banking-instruction-form.xlsx

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@grayline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@grayline.com
Date: 2026-10-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & payment path — quick follow-up after demo

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — the packet looks straightforward. Procurement prefers PO for our standard vendor relationship, but we can do the card route for the trial if Redwood can invoice us monthly and we can migrate to PO by month two. That would let our product team start without waiting for a full vendor onboarding.

I'll get the W-9 filled and return it by end of day Tuesday. Banking details: we need a secure form to submit routing/account numbers — procurement won't send that over email. Please place a vendor portal invite (we use a secure upload link) for "Erin Walsh" at this address: erin.walsh@grayline.com. Phone: +1 (312) 555-0199.

Also: any mandatory compliance paperwork (SOC 2, data processing addendum) that Finance requires? If so, please include links or the DPA.

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Walsh
Sr. Procurement Manager | Grayline Logistics
erin.walsh@grayline.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup & payment path — internal next steps (procurement + billing)

Team,

Summary of what Grayline asked for and our recommended path:

- Short term (recommended): enable card billing for the initial trial month, limit to $5k, automatically toggle to PO billing once Finance confirms vendor setup. This keeps the product trial smooth.
- Long term: support Net 30 PO with standard SOW and DPA. Procurement will require W-9 + banking instructions + SOC 2 link + Redacted sample invoice for payment terms.

Action items:
- Soojin: send portal invite and include redwood DPA + SOC2 link in the invite. (I can pull the SOC2 link and the redacted invoice)
- Dev: prep a redacted invoice template and confirm the invoice line items we use for trials (product credits vs actual consumption).
- Marissa: flag account as "PO conversion in progress" in HubSpot and add a task for Finance handoff next Tuesday.

I'll be available to join a procurement call Wed/Thu if needed.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@grayline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@grayline.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & payment path — quick follow-up after demo

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Quick update from procurement: we're comfortable starting with the card for October as a temporary measure. I'll upload the completed W-9 and our vendor banking upload to the portal once the invite is live. Procurement also asked for the SOC 2 report link and a copy of the DPA — can you please attach those when you send the portal invite?

We'll create the PO as soon as the vendor onboarding is complete — target PO creation by November 10. Let me know when the portal invite is sent and if you need anything else from my side.

Best,
Erin
